If local law requires permission from a parent or legal guardian to create an account, enter into an agreement, make a purchase, or consent to particular uses of personal data, that permission must be obtained before the relevant activity. A parent's permission does not override any minimum age imposed by applicable law.
legalUi.useAnEmailAddressYouControlComplete: Use an email address you control, complete email verification when requested, and keep your sign-in details private. legalUi.doNotHarassThreatenDiscriminateAgainstSc: Do not harass, threaten, discriminate against, scam, or impersonate other people. Do not post illegal, sexually explicit, or abusive content, including in profiles, custom images, GIFs, or messages.
legalUi.doNotUseBotsExploitBugsBypass: Do not use bots, exploit bugs, bypass access controls, manipulate trades or auctions, or create accounts to farm referrals and rewards.
legalUi.keepPrivateInformationPrivateDoNotShare: Keep private information private. Do not share someone else's personal information without a lawful basis. Report safety issues or suspected abuse using the available report tools or our contact email.
legalUi.regularPacksContainRandomVirtualCardsDec: Regular Packs contain random virtual cards. Decision Packs let you choose from the cards revealed. A pack does not guarantee a particular character or rarity unless an explicit offer says otherwise. Current pack information and rarity information are available in the game and on the <link1>Rarities page</link1>.
legalUi.cardsPacksAndKarasAreInGame: Cards, packs, and {currency} are in-game items, not money or an investment. They have no cash-redemption value and do not grant ownership of the characters or artwork they depict. Do not sell them for real money outside the service. Review the cards and {unit} amounts carefully before placing a bid or accepting a trade. Exchanges are subject to the game's ownership, balance, and eligibility checks.
legalUi.charactersFranchisesArtworkNamesAndTrade: Characters, franchises, artwork, names, and trademarks belong to their respective rights holders. Yokkai is not affiliated with or endorsed by them. Being displayed in the game does not mean that an image is free for other uses.
legalUi.youMustHaveTheNecessaryRightsOr: You must have the necessary rights or other lawful authorization for images, GIFs, messages, and other content you submit. You keep any rights you hold in your own content. You give Yokkai only the permission needed to host, process, and display that content to operate the features you use, including sharing it with the people or audiences you select. This does not transfer ownership of your content to Yokkai. Content may be removed when it violates rights or the community rules. Contact us to report a rights concern.
legalUi.someFeaturesSuchAsProSubscriptionsMay: Some features, such as Pro subscriptions, may require payment. legalUi.useAccountSettingsToManageTheAvailable: Use account settings to manage the available privacy controls, request an export of your account data, or delete your account. legalUi.toProtectCollectorsAndTheServiceWe: To protect collectors and the service, we may remove content, restrict features, or suspend accounts in response to rule violations, fraud, or security risks. legalUi.youMayStopUsingYokkaiAtAny: You may stop using Yokkai at any time and use account settings to request deletion. Review any active subscriptions, bids, and trades first. legalUi.forAccountHelpSafetyReportsRightsConcern: For account help, safety reports, rights concerns, or questions about these terms, email <link1>yokkaicollec@gmail.com</link1>. Never send your password or full payment details by email.

Shared context is only a review signal and never causes an automatic sanction.
